svg.font-family: Apple SD Gothic Neo, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: Masters are full-bleed 1024 (OS applies mask). Rounded / circle = mask preview. 16/32/48 are real rasters at that pixel size, shown at 1x and 3x (nearest-neighbour).
P1 Folded Page + bolt (접힌 페이지 + 번개)
P3 Highlight Line (인용 하이라이트 줄 + 번개)
